page.title: Authorizations
page.subtitle: Connect platform accounts to this workspace for posting and data access.

platform.grantHint: After scanning once, no new scan is needed for up to {{days}} days; re-authorize when it lapses or is revoked in the app.
platform.genericHint: Scan once to use this platform's capabilities.
platform.emptyManager: No account yet — use “Connect account” to start.
platform.emptyMember: No account yet — ask a workspace admin to connect one.

account.estimatedExpiry: Expected expiry {{date}} (new scan in about {{days}} days)

unbind.title: Disconnect this account?
unbind.body: “{{name}}” will be removed from this workspace. To revoke it entirely, use Douyin › Settings › Account & security › Authorizations.

publish.title: Post to Douyin
publish.intro: Pick a video from Resources to get a posting QR code. Scan it with the Douyin app and confirm there.
publish.noVideos: No postable videos in Resources (mp4/mov, ≤128 MB)
publish.caption: Caption
publish.scanHint: Open the Douyin app and scan
publish.scanSteps: Douyin downloads the video and opens its publish page; press Publish there.
publish.noTracking: No tracking id this time; this view will not update after you post.
publish.expiredHint: Close and generate a new one.
publish.videosError: Could not load videos (object storage unavailable)

state.noPlatforms: No platform is set up on this deployment.

mobile.authorizeReturnHint: Return to BossIP after confirming authorization in Douyin. The app will check account status again; opening the authorization page does not connect an account.
mobile.returnHint: Return to BossIP after using Douyin. The app will check the server again; opening Douyin does not mean the post was published.
mobile.authorizeIntro: Open the authorization page on this phone and confirm. The callback finishes in your browser; return to the app to check accounts. Cancelling does not connect an account.
mobile.publishIntro: Review the video, caption, hashtags and visibility, then generate a posting link. Open Douyin on this phone or use the backup QR code. You must confirm publication in Douyin yourself.
mobile.qrFallback: If Douyin cannot open, save the QR code or scan it with another device. Recognition from Photos depends on the Douyin version.
mobile.saveFailed: Could not save the QR code. Try again.
mobile.launchFailed: Could not open Douyin or the authorization page. Check that Douyin is installed, or use the backup QR code.
mobile.linkExpired: This link expired. Go back to generate another; the app will not repost automatically.
mobile.noJobs: No posting records in this workspace yet.
mobile.resumeJobHint: The server's posting record has been restored. Use the QR code in chat or continue in Douyin. Old links are never regenerated automatically.
mobile.statusUnconfirmed: The latest status could not be confirmed. Try again. Opening Douyin did not confirm publication.
mobile.createUncertain: If the connection dropped after sending, a record may already exist. Check Recent posts before retrying manually.
mobile.failedHint: Posting failed. Check the video and authorization before retrying manually.

errors.PLATFORM_ERROR: Something went wrong, try again later
errors.PLATFORM_DENIED: You cancelled the authorization on the platform
errors.PLATFORM_STATE_INVALID: The authorization link expired — start again
errors.PLATFORM_API_ERROR: The platform returned an error, try again later
errors.PUBLISH_STAGE_FAILED: Could not prepare the video, try again
errors.WORKSPACE_ROLE_REQUIRED: Only workspace admins can connect or disconnect accounts
